hooks.text: Four astronauts will soon travel farther from Earth than any humans ever.
How will a 2026 moon mission shatter Apollo 13's deep space record?
Four humans are about to fly thousands of miles past the Moon.

title: Breaking Apollo 13’s All-Time Deep Space Record
description: NASA's Artemis II mission will send four astronauts farther into deep space than any human flight in history.

beats.text: Four astronauts will soon travel farther from Earth than any humans ever.
beats.visual: Artemis II official crew portrait, NASA, 2023

beats.text: Artemis II is NASA’s first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
beats.visual: Space Launch System rocket on Launch Pad 39B, NASA, 2024

beats.text: Since 1972, every human spaceflight has remained confined to low Earth orbit.
beats.visual: Wide view of Earth from the International Space Station, NASA, 2023

beats.text: But commander Reid Wiseman and his crew will first climb into high Earth orbit.
beats.visual: Artist's concept of the Orion spacecraft in Earth orbit, NASA, 2022

beats.text: Powered by a European Service Module, their spacecraft, named Integrity, will reach between 44,000 and 46,000 miles.
beats.visual: Orion spacecraft and European Service Module during integration, NASA, 2023

beats.text: Pilot Victor Glover will then guide them on a slingshot around the lunar far side.
beats.visual: Craters on the lunar far side, Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter, 2011

beats.text: Mission specialist Jeremy Hansen will be the first non-American to leave Earth orbit.
beats.visual: Astronaut Jeremy Hansen in a flight suit, Canadian Space Agency, 2023

beats.text: This 10-day flight into deep space finally shatters the distance record held by Apollo 13.
beats.visual: Photograph of Earth from the Apollo 13 mission, NASA, 1970

beats.text: And in 2026, NASA will launch these.
beats.visual: Orion spacecraft after splashdown in the Pacific Ocean, NASA, 2022

better_than_last: Adjusted the closing loop line in beat 9 to match the reviewer's prompt, creating a perfectly flowing grammatical connection to beat 1.
